followup_explanation:
This was a benign, creative-fan-fiction style request (pairing a Power Rangers character with a Disney/Nickelodeon character) — no safety-sensitive or distasteful content involved. So the deciding factor is general capability.

Petrel-235B scores higher across the board, including on Creative Generation (84.7 vs. 78.8, a gap well beyond run-to-run variance) and on the public benchmarks. Since the query is essentially a creative-suggestion task and serving cost/latency/context are identical across the fleet, routing to the stronger model on the relevant dimension is the right call.

The task-preference notes about harm-adjacent content didn't factor in here — neither model has a relevant aversion, and the query isn't harm-adjacent anyway.

ROUTE: Petrel-235B
